objective: Meter the substrate without monetizing it: complete owner-derived ingestion into the existing durable UsageRecord chain so every charge is attributed (tenant, principal, provider, model route, model, resource and usage class — derived from the cited runtime receipts' owner records), bound to the exact frozen prices, metered at most once per tenant, accounted against the plan allowance, and aggregable as a read projection — while the substrate defines and sells no product value.
falsifiable_claim: POST /v1/hypervisor/economics/usage admits a v2 UsageRecord (managed-work-billing-ledger-bundle/v2 successor) whose metering_dimensions are DERIVED from the cited receipts' owner records (a model-invocation:// receipt is read through provider_transport's published reader and must belong to the caller's tenant; other schemes yield typed nulls and derivation caller_asserted; none of the metering members may be supplied by the caller), which carries the frozen quote/rate-card/plan body hashes, an admission-time measurement interval that says so, the caller's idempotency key and the owner's idempotency identity, and an entitlement_consumption record; a receipt already metered under a different key refuses economics_receipt_already_metered, a foreign tenant's receipt refuses economics_receipt_foreign_owner, an unresolved invocation refuses economics_receipt_unresolved, and an append past the plan allowance refuses economics_entitlement_exhausted unless the quote's uncovered active holds cover the excess (the record names which covered it). GET /v1/hypervisor/economics/usage/aggregate?by=<registered dimension> is a read-derived integer projection over the caller's admitted chains. The ledger-bundle export names the contract it met (v2 when every record is metered, v1 otherwise). npm run check:substrate-metering-contract pins all of it as a closed cargo test population with eight source pins and two supplementary gates.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: economics_routes::tests 13/13 (four new): dimensions derived from a seeded invocation record and caller-supplied derivations refused for six members; the same receipt under a new key refused by name with the binding record named, a foreign tenant's invocation refused 403, an unresolved invocation refused, the chain unchanged after each; a 100-credit allowance consumed over two appends, the third refused, an exact 50-credit hold covering exactly one more (covered_by credit_hold) and the next refused again; the aggregate by principal and by meter class with an unattributed bucket for a caller-asserted record, an unregistered dimension refused, and an outsider identity seeing nothing. The population gate's --mutation self-drill refuses a planted absent test, an unlistable name and an empty family. The generated fixture bar was proven to evaluate the new v2 negatives by making one valid and watching check:architecture-contracts go red.
remaining_nonclaims: Session, GoalRun, environment, worker-instance and package-release attribution are typed nulls today: no runtime receipt this module can read carries them; the invocation record carries principal, provider, route and model only.
measurement_interval is the admission instant with interval_basis admission_time: no receipt this module reads carries a measured interval; a receipt-timestamped interval is a later producer's fact.
Supplier reconciliation is M07.3's: supplier_reconciliation_state stays estimated until a statement binds, and the bundle's assurance_status remains internal_event_log.
The substrate meters, attests, authorizes, records or settles; it defines and sells no product value — no price, plan or product rule is minted here.

check:substrate-metering-contract is a root population gate and is not CI-bound as a step of its own; its children are (the daemon tests in Build and Test, check:architecture-contracts, and M07.1's gate).

A same-key retry of a usage append is the substrate's replay; the test asserts only that it never doubles the chain and is never read as already metered, because the record's occurred_at_ms is the admission instant.
